pages.text: NOOP means "no operation": a NOOP line does nothing.$(br2)Use NOOP lines to separate parts of your program. A NOOP line may not hold any other block, not even a COMMENT. Line 1 of every program is a NOOP line, and every FUNCTION needs one right above it.
NOOP blocks are also the base of most other recipes.
Put iron ingots in the four corners and sticks on the four sides, and leave the middle empty. You get 64 NOOP blocks.
$(1)PROGRAM first$(br)NOOP$(br)NOOP$(br)FUNCTION answer$(br)  RESULT result INTEGER$(br)BEGIN$(br)  ASSIGN result 42 ;$(br)END FUNCTION$()
